convergence.note: n-window 72..78 -> 71..79 adds 2672 pair states (n=71,79 channels) with zero dipole coupling to the target, so V(4 um) is unchanged; convergence is genuine (far-n channels decouple).

premise_corrections.premise: E4 assumed the perturbative C6(75)=3482 GHz.um^6 is a LOWER bound on the interaction (actual V stronger), giving V(4 um)=C6/4^6=850 MHz.
premise_corrections.corrected: Full pair-Hamiltonian diagonalization gives V(4 um)=-152 MHz (5.6x SMALLER, not larger). The near-Foerster channel |75S+76S> at +0.185 GHz puts R=4 um in the strong-mixing regime (|rr> purity 0.469), where the perturbative R^-6 formula fails.
premise_corrections.consequence: E4's blockade leakage at 40 MHz (1.107e-3) is a 4.3x OVERestimate; the full-dynamics value is 2.555e-4. E4's 'blockade-limited at high Omega' verdict is directionally CORRECT (blockade is still the dominant channel at 40 MHz, 10.6x above recoil) but the leakage magnitude is ~4x smaller. The F(40)<F(10) ordering and the ~19-20 MHz optimum survive.

acceptance_criterion: Confirmatory. Predict: (i) the full pair-Hamiltonian diagonalization at n=75, theta=90 deg finds R=4 um is NOT in the R^-6 tail regime (near-Foerster resonance |75S+76S> at +0.185 GHz strongly mixes the doubly-excited state) and |V(4 um)| is substantially smaller than the perturbative C6(3482 GHz.um^6)/R^6 = 850 MHz; (ii) the full master-equation gate simulation preserves the E4 ordering F(40 MHz) < F(10 MHz). Verdict reads computed.pair_potential.r6_tail_describes_4um AND computed.master_equation.f40_lt_f10. CONFIRMED iff r6_tail_describes_4um == false AND f40_lt_f10 == true. REFUTED if r6_tail_describes_4um == true OR f40_lt_f10 == false. Single-fault check: V must respond to R (V(4 um) != V(8 um)) and fidelity must respond to Omega (F(40 MHz) != F(10 MHz)).
